children: Kempinski Group, Europe’s oldest luxury hospitality company, has announced the launch of Kempinski Residences The Creek, featuring 279 luxury apartments surrounded by natural landscapes, offering a serene lifestyle complemented by premium amenities and exquisite services.

Developed by Swiss Property, a Dubai-based boutique development firm focused on premium and luxury contemporary homes with a harmonious approach to sophisticated design, art, and engineering, the project brings Kempinski’s 150-year legacy of luxury hospitality to one of the city’s most scenic neighbourhoods, with panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Creek Harbour or the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary.

Barbara Muckermann, CEO, Kempinski Group, said: "As Curators of The Good Life, we’ve ensured our residents experience more than the European elegance, design, and legendary service we are known for. As we evolve a new expression of Kempinski’s Good Life, we offer residents meaningful engagement with the world: with the destination, its culture, its cuisine and finding the connection with one's own life."

"Nestled in natural surroundings and overlooking the waters of the Creek in the heart of Dubai, the residence has been conceptualised to generously merge indoor and outdoor spaces, creating real access to the destination and bring a sense of well-being and joy to all residents," he stated.

"The UAE, and the GCC more broadly, represents a strategic focus for Kempinski as the demand for branded residences continues to evolve. We are proud to add Kempinski Residences The Creek to our collection of distinguished global, residential properties," he added.

Karim Adi, CEO of Swiss Property, said: "Kempinski Residences The Creek was founded on two principles that we believe are increasingly important in modern living: human connection and healthy living. Our ambition was to create an environment that naturally brings people together, encourages an active and balanced lifestyle, and creates a genuine sense of community."

"Every aspect of the project, from its relationship with nature and outdoor spaces to its amenities and shared areas, was shaped around these principles. For us, true luxury is ultimately about how a place makes you live, feel and connect with others," he noted.

According to Kempinski, these residences feature premium amenities like a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, squash court, Padel court, butler service, all-day dining restaurant, spa and 24/7 security.

Children are also taken care of with an indoor kids’ room and an outdoor park. Surrounded both by a wildlife reserve and the sprawling Dubai metropolis, Kempinski Residences The Creek offers a balanced lifestyle, combining natural tranquillity and urban sophistication, it stated.

"Building on the momentum in Dubai, Kempinski will also launch Kempinski Marina Residences in 2029. Taking its prominent position at the iconic Dubai Marina, it offers residents unparalleled luxury and comfort, with the city’s magnificent attractions surrounding visitors and residents alike," remarked Muckermann.
With its architecturally designed vertical gardens set on staggered balconies, understated and elegant interiors, Kempinski Marina Residences raises craftsmanship and design to new levels, she added.

Kempinski’s residences have become highly coveted residential destinations within the GCC, alongside Kempinski Harbour Heights Hotel and Residences Manama, Bahrain, a sky-high sanctuary of luxury living in the heart of Bahrain Harbour, and Kempinski Hotel and Residences at Masar, Makkah, which offers luxury hospitality to the prestigious Masar development, in the heart of Makkah, within the vicinity of the Grand Mosque.
